message.content:
Search this repository (breadth: very thorough) for code related to memo metadata that is derived/computed from memo content. I'm looking for:

1. Where memo "snippet" or "preview" or "excerpt" or derived metadata is computed from memo content
2. What triggers recomputation (e.g., create, update, patch operations)
3. What properties are extracted (e.g., title, snippet, visibility, etc.)

Search for patterns like:
- "snippet" in relation to memos
- memo metadata computation
- extracting properties from memo content
- memo content parsing for previews/lists
- Any function that processes memo content to derive display properties

Look in store files, service files, API handlers, and utility files. Check for terms like "snippet", "excerpt", "preview", "metadata", "derive", "compute", "extract", "parse" in memo-related code.

- graphify: Use for any question about a codebase, its architecture, file relationships, or project content — especially when graphify-out/ exists, where the question should be treated as a graphify query first. Turns any input (code, docs, papers, images, videos) into a persistent knowledge graph with god nodes, community detection, and query/path/explain tools.
- dataviz: Use this skill whenever you are about to create ANY chart, graph, plot, dashboard, or data visualization, in ANY output medium — an HTML or React artifact, inline SVG, plotting code in any library (matplotlib, plotly, d3, Recharts, …), an image/PNG you will render and upload, or a chart shared into Slack. Read it BEFORE writing the first line of chart code, choosing chart colors, building a stat tile / meter / KPI row, or laying out a dashboard. Produces visualizations that read as one system — elegant, accessible, consistent in light and dark — using a brand-neutral placeholder palette you swap for your own. Teaches a design-system-agnostic method: a form heuristic, a color formula with a runnable validator, mark specs, and interaction rules. A validated default palette is documented in `references/palette.md` — swap that file's values for your brand's. Triggers on: "chart", "graph", "plot", "data viz", "visualization", "dashboard", "analytics", "visualize data", "categorical colors", "sequential / diverging palette", "stat tile", "sparkline", "heatmap", "legend", "axis", "tooltip", "chart colors", "color by series".
- update-config: Use this skill to configure the Claude Code harness via settings.json. Automated behaviors ("from now on when X", "each time X", "whenever X", "before/after X") require hooks configured in settings.json - the harness executes these, not Claude, so memory/preferences cannot fulfill them. Also use for: permissions ("allow X", "add permission", "move permission to"), env vars ("set X=Y"), hook troubleshooting, or any changes to settings.json/settings.local.json files. Examples: "allow npm commands", "add bq permission to global settings", "move permission to user settings", "set DEBUG=true", "when claude stops show X". For simple settings like theme/model, suggest the /config command.
- keybindings-help: Use when the user wants to customize keyboard shortcuts, rebind keys, add chord bindings, or modify ~/.claude/keybindings.json. Examples: "rebind ctrl+s", "add a chord shortcut", "change the submit key", "customize keybindings".
- simplify: Review the changed code for reuse, simplification, efficiency, and altitude cleanups, then apply the fixes. Quality only — it does not hunt for bugs; use /code-review for that.
- fewer-permission-prompts: Scan your transcripts for common read-only Bash and MCP tool calls, then add a prioritized allowlist to project .claude/settings.json to reduce permission prompts.
- loop: Run a prompt or slash command on a recurring interval (e.g. /loop 5m /foo, defaults to 10m) - When the user wants to set up a recurring task, poll for status, or run something repeatedly on an interval (e.g. "check the deploy every 5 minutes", "keep running /babysit-prs"). Do NOT invoke for one-off tasks.
- claude-api: Reference for the Claude API / Anthropic SDK — model ids, pricing, params, streaming, tool use, MCP, agents, caching, token counting, model migration.
TRIGGER — read BEFORE opening the target file; don't skip because it "looks like a one-liner" — whenever: the prompt names Claude/Anthropic in any form (Claude, Anthropic, Fable, Opus, Sonnet, Haiku, `anthropic`, `@anthropic-ai`, `claude-*`, `us.anthropic.*`, `[1m]`); the user asks about an LLM (pricing/model choice/limits/caching) — never answer from memory; OR the task is LLM-shaped with provider unstated (agent/MCP/tool-definition/multi-agent/RAG/LLM-judge/computer-use; generate/summarize/extract/classify/rewrite/converse over NL; debugging refusals/cutoffs/streaming/tool-calls/tokens).
SKIP only when another provider is being worked on (overrides all triggers): OpenAI/GPT/Gemini/Llama/Mistral/Cohere/Ollama named in the query; OR `grep -rE 'openai|langchain_openai|google.generativeai|genai|mistralai|cohere|ollama'` over the project hits (run this grep FIRST if no provider named — don't Read the file).
- run: Launch and drive this project's app to see a change working. Use when asked to run, start, or screenshot the app, or to confirm a change works in the real app (not just tests). First looks for a project skill that already covers launching the app; otherwise falls back to built-in patterns per project type (CLI, server, TUI, Electron, browser-driven, library).

## Memo Metadata Derived from Content: Complete Analysis

This codebase is the **usememos/memos** application -- a Go backend with a React/TypeScript frontend. Memo metadata is computed from memo content (Markdown) in two distinct categories: (A) **persisted payload** (tags, properties) computed at write time and stored in the database, and (B) **on-the-fly derived fields** (snippet, RSS title) computed at read time and never stored.

---

### 1. WHERE DERIVED METADATA IS COMPUTED

#### A. Persisted payload: `RebuildMemoPayload` (tags + property)

The central function is `RebuildMemoPayload` at:

**`/bench/home/work/server/runner/memopayload/runner.go`** (lines 74-88)

It calls `markdownService.ExtractAll()` which parses the Markdown content once and extracts:
- **Tags** (all `#tag` occurrences in content, deduplicated, case-preserving)
- **Property** (a `MemoPayload_Property` struct with the following boolean/string fields):
  - `HasLink` -- true if any markdown link exists
  - `HasCode` -- true if any code block (fenced, indented) or inline code span exists
  - `HasTaskList` -- true if any GFM task checkbox exists
  - `HasIncompleteTasks` -- true if any unchecked `[ ]` task exists
  - `Title` -- plain text of the first H1 heading if it is the very first block-level child of the document

The `ExtractAll` implementation is at:

**`/bench/home/work/internal/markdown/markdown.go`** (lines 356-422)

This is a single-pass AST walk using goldmark. It collects tags (from custom `TagNode`), mentions (from custom `MentionNode`), and all Property fields simultaneously. The Markdown service is created with `WithTagExtension()` and `WithMentionExtension()` at server startup:

**`/bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/v1.go`** (lines 48-51)

The tags and property are stored in the `MemoPayload` protobuf, persisted as part of the memo row. The store-level proto definition is at:

**`/bench/home/work/proto/store/memo.proto`** (lines 7-29)

#### B. On-the-fly snippet: `getMemoContentSnippet` / `GenerateSnippet`

The snippet is computed on read, **never stored in the database**. It is an `OUTPUT_ONLY` field in the API proto.

The central helper is:

**`/bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go`** (lines 83-90)

```go
func (s *APIV1Service) getMemoContentSnippet(content string) (string, error) {
    snippet, err := s.MarkdownService.GenerateSnippet([]byte(content), 64)
    ...
}
```

This calls the Markdown service's `GenerateSnippet` method at:

**`/bench/home/work/internal/markdown/markdown.go`** (lines 264-346)

`GenerateSnippet` walks the goldmark AST and:
- Extracts plain text from text nodes, autolinks, and tag nodes
- Skips fenced and indented code blocks entirely (but keeps inline code span text)
- Adds spaces between block-level elements (paragraphs, headings, list items, table cells)
- Truncates at a word/rune boundary if exceeding `maxLength` (64 characters for the memo snippet)
- Appends `" ..."` when truncated

#### C. RSS title: `generateItemTitle`

**`/bench/home/work/server/router/rss/rss.go`** (lines 302-336)

This is a separate, simpler extraction for RSS feeds:
- Takes the first line of content
- Strips markdown heading syntax (`#` to `######`)
- Truncates at 100 characters at a word boundary
- Falls back to `"Memo"` if empty

#### D. RSS HTML content: `getRSSItemDescription`

**`/bench/home/work/server/router/rss/rss.go`** (lines 338-344)

Renders full memo Markdown content to HTML using `MarkdownService.RenderHTML()` for RSS `<description>` and `<content:encoded>`.

---

### 2. WHAT TRIGGERS RECOMPUTATION

#### Persisted payload (tags, property) -- triggers:

| Trigger | File | Line(s) | What happens |
|---------|------|---------|-------------|
| **CreateMemo** | `/bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go` | 108 | `memopayload.RebuildMemoPayload(ctx, create, s.MarkdownService)` called before `Store.CreateMemo` |
| **UpdateMemo** (when `content` is in update mask) | `/bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go` | 447 | `memopayload.RebuildMemoPayload(ctx, memo, s.MarkdownService)` called, then `update.Content` and `update.Payload` are both set |
| **Batch recomputation (all memos)** | `/bench/home/work/server/runner/memopayload/runner.go` | 27-72 | `Runner.RunOnce()` iterates all memos in batches of 100, rebuilds each payload, and updates it via `Store.UpdateMemo`. This runner is NOT started automatically on server boot in the current code; it exists for manual/migration use. |

Key detail: When UpdateMemo is called but the `content` field is **not** in the update mask (e.g., only `visibility`, `pinned`, `state`, or `location` changes), the payload is NOT recomputed. Only the relevant update fields are set.

#### On-the-fly snippet -- triggers (computed at read time):

| Trigger | File | Line(s) |
|---------|------|---------|
| **convertMemoFromStoreWithCreators** (every API read) | `/bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/memo_service_converter.go` | 76-80 |
| **batchConvertMemoRelations** (relation snippets) | `/bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/memo_service_converter.go` | 224-252 |
| **convertMemoRelationFromStore** (ListMemoRelations) | `/bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/memo_relation_service.go` | 154, 162 |
| **memoNotificationSnippet** (notification payloads) | `/bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/user_service_notifications.go` | 318-328, 346-391 |

The snippet is regenerated every time a memo is returned from any API endpoint (GetMemo, ListMemos, CreateMemo response, UpdateMemo response, GetMemoByShare, ListMemoComments, etc.) because it flows through `convertMemoFromStoreWithCreators`.

---

### 3. WHAT PROPERTIES ARE EXTRACTED

| Property | Source | Stored? | Proto Location |
|----------|--------|---------|----------------|
| **Tags** (`[]string`) | `#tag` syntax parsed by custom goldmark extension | Yes (in `MemoPayload.tags`) | `store/memo.proto:20`, API: `memo_service.proto:241` |
| **Title** (`string`) | First H1 heading's plain text, if H1 is the first block child | Yes (in `MemoPayload.Property.title`) | `store/memo.proto:18`, API: `memo_service.proto:278` |
| **HasLink** (`bool`) | Any `[text](url)` markdown link node | Yes (in `MemoPayload.Property.has_link`) | `store/memo.proto:13` |
| **HasCode** (`bool`) | Any fenced code block, indented code block, or inline code span | Yes (in `MemoPayload.Property.has_code`) | `store/memo.proto:15` |
| **HasTaskList** (`bool`) | Any GFM task checkbox (`- [ ]` or `- [x]`) | Yes (in `MemoPayload.Property.has_task_list`) | `store/memo.proto:14` |
| **HasIncompleteTasks** (`bool`) | Any unchecked checkbox (`- [ ]`) | Yes (in `MemoPayload.Property.has_incomplete_tasks`) | `store/memo.proto:16` |
| **Snippet** (`string`) | Plain text summary, max 64 chars, truncated at word boundary | No (computed on read) | API only: `memo_service.proto:267` |
| **Mentions** (`[]string`) | `@username` syntax parsed by custom goldmark extension | Not stored in payload; used to dispatch inbox notifications | Extracted by `ExtractAll` |
| **Visibility** | Not derived from content -- set by user | Yes (in `store.Memo.Visibility`) | separate column |
| **Location** | Not derived from content -- set by user request | Yes (in `MemoPayload.Location`) | separate field |
